abdomen.label: Abdomen
abdomen.describe: albedo of the pale grey-tan margin round the folium and the flanks and underside of the abdomen

folium.label: Folium
folium.describe: albedo of the folium, the warm brown leaf-shaped band down the middle of the abdomen's back that holds the white cross

marks.label: Marks
marks.describe: albedo of the white spots inside the folium: the cross's front dash and dot, its centre blob and two crossbar arms, the blob and short upper pair behind it, and the blobs and dot pair between the dark tiers behind those

carapace.label: Carapace
carapace.describe: albedo of the pale parts of the cephalothorax (the margin ring round its rim, the eye face and crown), the four spinneret knobs under the rear of the abdomen and the leg spines

legs.label: Legs
legs.describe: albedo of the grey-brown leg and pedipalp segments (coxae, femora, knees, tibiae, metatarsi, tarsi), the sternum and the rear of the cephalothorax under its rim

mottle.label: Mottle
mottle.describe: albedo of the darker mottling: the streaks along the leg segments, the patellae, the soft front edge of the folium, a fleck under the abdomen's rear point and the upper lateral bands of the cephalothorax

bands.label: Bands
bands.describe: albedo of the dark brown: the folium's scalloped rim, the lobes beside the crossbar and the chevrons of the tiers behind it, the rings on every femur, tibia and metatarsus, the lower palp segments, the chelicerae, the carapace's lateral bands and the dark band round the face under the eyes

tips.label: Tips
tips.describe: albedo of the pointed tarsus tips, the palp tarsi and the fangs, a rung darker than the leg bands

eyes.label: Eyes
eyes.describe: albedo of the eight small eye beads, the darkest thing on the spider

size.label: Overall size
size.describe: scales the whole spider and its rig together (1 = an adult female, body about 2.5 kit metres long, abdomen crown 1.4 kit metres up)

fullness.label: Abdomen fullness
fullness.describe: how swollen the abdomen is, grown from the pedicel with the same shoulder humps and folium: 0.9 a slim female, 1.1 a gravid one

legReach.label: Leg reach
legReach.describe: how far the eight legs spread from the body; the knees keep their height and every tarsus stays on the ground

legThickness.label: Leg thickness
legThickness.describe: stoutness of the banded leg and palp tubes and their pale knees

stance.label: Knee carriage
stance.describe: how high the knees arch above the body; the body height and the planted tarsi do not move
